notes.title: Free DLC "The Witcher Awakening" is available now
notes.content:
[h1]"The Witcher Awakening": New content and Improvements[/h1]

[h2]New weapon type: Ornaments[/h2]

New weapons have been added to the already wide and varied arsenal of the King of Darkness. Between swords, scythes, and pistols, now we can choose ornaments, magical artifacts with a destructive capacity that will delight his dar majesty (and also his followers).

Now players will be able to unlock this new type of weapon in the Famished Town forge and enjoy its 10 variants. Each of these ornaments features a unique design and attack patterns, in addition to the possibility of being ascended to the Summum level to unleash their full destructive potential.

The ascension diagrams can be obtained by performing certain feats with ornaments or completing specific missions... Everything will depend on the particular weapon.

With the inclusion of ornaments, a new weapon progression tree has also been added to the Starving City forge. Improve the attributes of this new type of weapon in each of the 8 branches and achieve the best performance in combat. A new gene called "Witchcraft" has also been added that increases the damage the King of Darkness does when wearing ornaments.

[h2]List of new weapons[/h2]

[b]- Basic Ornament[/b]
An ornament for rookies, no enchantments or special attributes

[b]- Frost Hydra[/b]
Launches icy spikes that deal cold damage
Invokes an orb that launches ice spikes at enemies in its way
[u]Summum:[/u] A layer of ice surrounds you, making you immune for a time while shooting spikes at nearby enemies.

[b]- Jibaro[/b]
Fires a voodoo projectile
Invokes zombies to fight at your side
[u]Summum:[/u] Angers your host by increasing their abilities

[b]- Dragon Claw[/b]
All attacks from this ornament deal fire damage
Invokes a fireball that explodes upon impact, causing area damage.
[u]Summum:[/u] Invokes a dragon that devastates the battlefield with a flare

[b]- Retro Controller[/b]
invokes a ship that will follow you and attack automatically
When killing enemies, there is a chance of power-ups spawning
You can modify its position or make it follow you.
[u]Summum:[/u] Bombs the screen with giant retroprojectiles

[b]- Basaltic Golem[/b]
Invokes a stone fist that hits at close range
Invokes two giant fists that stun all enemies in their impact area.
[u]Summum:[/u] Grants a shield

[b]- Áuryn[/b]
Invokes a retractable spear of roots that strikes enemies in its area.
Invokes poisonous spores into the world that are destroyed when hit with the roots.
Invokes a flurry of roots that hit all enemies in its area
[u]Summum:[/u] Invokes a Sprout of Eternity

[b]- Typhoon[/b]
Invokes Typhon who will follow you and attack automatically
Creates a wind explosion around Typhoon that deals area damage.
You can modify its position with the primary attack
[u]Summum:[/u] Generates a tornado around Typhon that attracts enemies towards its center

[b]- Elven Lyre[/b]
Throws a musical note and every certain number of notes throw a powered one
Releases a chord that enthralls the enemy for a time
[u]Summum:[/u] Throw chords in all directions

[b]- Holy Scriptures[/b]
All attacks from this ornament deal holy damage
Invokes a spiraling hammer
Invokes a celestial mallet that bounces off surfaces, striking enemies in its path
[u]Summum:[/u] Launches a purifying ray that hits enemies in its area. The beam can be directed in any direction

[h2]Seed history[/h2]

The friendly botanist of Famished Town has created a seed history allowing players to check information about all the adventures they have already enjoyed, including genetic data and several statistics.

This addition is located in Yado's hut, just to the right of the seed germinator.

[h2]New status ailments[/h2]

2 new status ailments have been added:

- Cold: Adds cold charges to the enemy and freezes them when it reaches 100
- Charm: Enemies affected by this status will fight on your side

[h2]New skins[/h2]

5 new skins have been included for the King of Darkness:

- Spider Sense
- Lich King
- Déjà vu
- Starborn
- Tropic Thunder

[h2]New achievements[/h2]

5 new achievements have been added related to the inclusion of ornaments:

- Wizard: Unlock the ornament
- Gun Nut: Fully upgrade (damage node not included) 4 weapon types
- Do It Yourself: Forge 16 new weapons
- Expert Weapon Tester: Unlock 36 relic weapons with Dummytama
- Expert Summum: Unlock 36 ascended weapons with Dummytama

[h2]Bugs fixed[/h2]
- Fixed some typos
- Fixed a bug where the end run screen would sometimes crash
- Fixed an issue where the Argentum Pistol Ascension Chart could not be obtained when completing the requirement: defeat Count Xander with that weapon
- Fixed a bug where the ascension diagram for the Touch of Death scythe could not be obtained when fulfilling the requirement: spin the Death Roulette while that weapon is equipped

[list]
[*] A new "Equipment" system has been included
[list]During your adventures you will now find different pieces of armor equipped with statistical improvements, in addition, each piece belongs to a collection and by equipping multiple pieces from the same collection you will unlock new and incredible powers.[/list]
[/list][h2]New NPC:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New NPC Available "Alfred, at the service of his majesty"

[/list][h2]Altered states:[/h2]

[list]Corruption
Sacred[/list]
[/list][h2]Gems:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The operation of some gems has been adjusted and redesigned to adapt them to the new progression system
[*] 3 new gems have been added:
[list]- Inferno: Adds fire damage charges

[/list][h2]New weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The operation of some weapons has been adjusted and redesigned to adapt them to the new progression system
[*] 3 new weapons have been added:
[list]- Inquisitor: A sword forged to punish heretics and convert pagans, wielded by the leader of a now-extinct religious order.
- Anathema: A scythe bathed in the blood of a martyr and blessed by the Worshipers of Chaos. A cursed weapon, for less civilized times.

[/list][h2]Game progress:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The difficulty system has been redesigned by further adjusting the scaling and difficulty curve, thanks to these new adjustments now all the game content will be accessible to any type of player, from the most casual to the most hardcore, maintaining still its essence and always posing a challenge for each of them.

Longevity II[/list][*] Added new improvements to the Ancient Tree:

notes.title: 6 days left for the ultimate Roguelite experience!
notes.content:
[h1]The clock is ticking...[/h1]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42192295/2f3a82a8e68798dec533714993a8ead7b7c53518.png[/img]

What makes Summum Aeterna a unique Roguelite experience?

Among its gameplay features, the [b]seed mechanic[/b] is the most anticipated.

Summum Aeterna includes a unique world generator system never seen before in the genre, the Seed Mechanic... Each one generates a unique world with different enemy behaviour, special events, and even a larger map size, depending on the rarity and the genes contained in the germinated seed.

The world modifiers, so-called “seed genes” are positive and negative attributes included in each seed you find. They will determine the dangers, encounters and rewards waiting for you once you start playing. You can generate the world that best suits your playstyle.

Seeds create worlds and genes make each seed different from the last, and so will the worlds generated from them!

Mark [b]Septemeber 14[/b] on your calendars :)

notes.title: Aeternum Game Studios release schedule
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42192295/1edde10a5cb0655d17e9862f87d76a2d24885af0.png[/img]

It's been a week since the last Aeternum Game Studios showcase! 

The event featured interesting news about the future of the franchise and the studio's new projects. In addition to delving into the mechanics and gameplay that make Summum Aeterna a unique Roguelite, we also confirmed a new DLC for Aeterna Noctis coming later this year, and Eden Genesis, a new IP apart from the Universe Aeterna.

Let's take a look at the next releases for 2023 and 2024:

[b]- Summum Aeterna:[/b] A Roguelite game and prequel to Aeterna Noctis. The game includes the so-called "seed mechanic" a tool that allows players to set up runs on demand by adding and removing genes. Since the germinated worlds from seeds never repeat themselves, they will always be unique, and if you add the influences, everything will be even more chaotic. notes.title: "Demons' Mother" Update is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/d272c074f6f438bee988221f73d4a1556b55aa0e.jpg[/img]

Summum Aeterna releases its first major update called "Mother of Demons", now available on Steam and packed with new content for the Roguelite from the creators of Aeterna Noctis.

Following in the footsteps of our roadmap, we've just released the first of many updates to extend the content for our latest project. "Mother of Demons" is the name of this first major update which adds many hours of fun to the adventures of the King of Darkness in Roguelite format. Here you can see the teaser:

https://youtu.be/aq4JAHhbHqo
[h1]New content and improvements included in "Demons' Mother" Update[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the radius and improved the visual effect of the "Unleashed Plague" upgrade on the scythe
[*] Added a visual effect on enemies and the King when affected by status ailments
[*] The "Frozen" ailment can now also affect the King
[list]Suffering from this state will prevent the King from moving and he will be vulnerable to attacks. He will be able to regain mobility by repeatedly pressing the attack button, receiving an enemy hit or passing the certain freezing time[/list][*] Dash's "Cooldown Time" has been reduced to improve its response on the ground
[/list]
[h2]Rooms and events:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New challenge room: "Shrine of Idalith"
[list]The rooms in honor of the one known as "Mother of Demons" contain a special treasure called "Offering to Idalith", to obtain it you must defeat a random member of the "Grim Horde".[/list][*] 3 minibosses: The minions of Idalith protect the treasures of their infernal lady (currently 3 minibosses available)[list]"Valatuk, Lord of War" 
"Samnidas, Plaguebearer" 
"Ledasios, Grand Inquisitor"
[/list][/list]
[h2]Seeds:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New seed type: "World Seed"
[list]They will create a new adventure setting the initial world with the one associated with this seed [/list][*] New World Seed: "Eclipse Citadel"
[*] New World Seed: "Harunokaze Village"
[*] Current seeds have been transformed into "World Seeds" of type "Eclipse Citadel"
[*] The maximum number of seeds the King can carry has been increased from 40 to 999
[*] It is now possible to sort seeds by level, rarity and drop
[*] Added a "skulls" marker in the seed info to indicate their difficulty
[/list]
[h2]Worlds:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Eclipse Citadel world area 1 has been expanded with 20 new rooms
[*] Eclipse Citadel world area 2 has been expanded with 25 new rooms
[*] Reduced the size of world area 1 "Harunokaze Village" to shorten its duration
[/list]
[h2]Genes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New lethal gene: "Assassination"
[list]Increased damage and health of bosses (Available on seeds level 40 or higher)[/list][*] New lethal gene: "Tyrant"
[list]Bosses are more difficult. The reward obtained after defeating a boss under the influence of this gene will be doubled (Available in seeds of level 45 or higher)[/list][*] New Structural Gene: "Survival": Adds a "Guardian Angel" charge to the King
[*] Changed the "Gold" structural gene to give a percentage of current Dogmas instead of a flat amount when discovering new rooms
[/list]
[h2]NPCs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Dummytama, Test Subject"
[list]You will be able to test basic weapons of any kind against him without leaving Famished City and this is just the beginning...[/list][*] "Rasen Lupine, Knight and Thief"
[list]Trades in items of dubious origin in Famished City, allowing the King to quickly obtain seeds of different types and levels for a "fair" price. He will only appear when the streets are deserted, he likes to keep his merchandise out of the reach of prying eyes...[/list]
[/list][h2]Gems:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Gem: "Epidemic"
[list]When an enemy affected by status ailments dies, it will transfer those statuses to nearby enemies (Rarity upgrade: +1 to contagion distance) [/list][*] New Gem: "Static Bow"
[list]Hitting an enemy will create a lightning bolt that will damage the nearest enemy for 50% of your damage (Will not damage the same enemy more than once) (Rarity upgrade: +1 enemy, +5% to damage)[/list]
[/list][h2]Weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New sword "Jade Katana":
[list]Increase your attack speed by 5% for 2 seconds for each hit to the enemy (Max 5 charges) (Rarity upgrade: 1% attack speed)[/list][*] New scythe "Mantis Claw":
[list]Increases your attack speed by 5%. On cast, double the buff for 2 seconds for each enemy killed (Buff Rarity: 5% Attack Speed)[/list][*] New gun "Taser":
[list]Hitting an enemy will trigger a lightning bolt that will strike a nearby target for 25% of the initial damage. The effect will repeat 1 time (Rarity Boost: +5% to damage and +1 target)[/list][*] The buff duration of the "Spirit of the Executioner" scythe has been changed from 1 to 2 seconds per executed enemy
[*] Changed the health recovery gained by the "Healing Grim Reaper" scythe from +0.5% to +0.2% per rarity level to balance it with the other weapons
[*] The attack speed calculation on the swords has been modified to balance them with the other weapons
[*] Fixed King sword attack animations bugs when attack speed was increased
[*] Now the projectiles of the pistol "Quadcannon" have auto-aiming
[*] Improved the visual effect of swords when they are thrown
[*] Fixed a bug where scythe curse charges would sometimes not stack correctly
[*] Pistol projectiles will now be destroyed when leaving the King's view range to avoid hitting off-screen enemies
[*] Plague Scythe curse damage increased from 20% to 25% per rarity to balance it with other weapons
[*] Increased the healing received from the heavy projectiles of the "Bloodsucker" pistol from 3% to 5% base and from 1% to 3% per rarity level to balance it with the other weapons
[/list]
[h2]Game Progress:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New improvements available in the "Tree of Eternity" in Famished City:
[list]"Demonic Cult": Unlocks the spawn of the "Shrine of Idalith" room in the worlds
"Wholesaler": It is now possible to change a shop's items randomly in exchange for several Dogmas
"Foolish": It is now possible to make an extra roll for each Wheel of Death in exchange for several Dogmas[/list][*] New upgrades available in the "Two Crowns Fountain" in Famished City:
[list]"Empowered Curse": Increases your damage by 5% when cursed (Upgrade per level: Increases damage by 5%)
"Adamite Seeker": Enemies now have a chance to drop ingots on death (Upgrade per level: Increases chance)
"Sapiens": Enemies now have a chance to drop sap on death (Upgrade per level: Increases chance) [/list][/list]
[h2]User interface:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Patch notes have been included in the main menu
[*] The following options have been added to the "Game" menu:
[list]Auto-Aim Guns: On / Off
Weapon Auto-Spin: Always On / Only On Ground / Off[/list][*] The "Rooms not yet discovered" marker has been modified to improve its visibility
[*] Added scroll to the "Hexes" list
[*] The design of the enemies' life bar has been modified
[*] The design of the "Guardian Angel" indicator has been modified
[*] Decreased the update speed of the life bar when the King is hit to make it easier to see
[*] Options menu UI graphics changed
[/list]
[h2]Bosses:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dantilus: New difficulty added (Hard)
[*] Umehara: New difficulty added (Hard)
[*] Danger warnings have been added to the projectiles fired by "Umehara" when they are out of the King's vision
[*] Fixed a bug where damage from bosses was not calculated correctly when starting the game directly in their lobby
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Freeze" ailment would sometimes disable Umehara's melee damage
[/list]
[h2]Various:[/h2]
[list]
[*] It is not always daytime in "Famine City" now sometimes it will be dark
[*] Fixed a bug where some Chest Rooms would not change their "Completed" icon on the map and minimap
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the Weapon Upgrade Popup when using Tree of Eternity flowers
[*] Fixed a bug where damage was displayed incorrectly in shops when "Master Sword" was equipped with its enchantment active
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would rotate incorrectly when falling from a platform
[*] Fixed a bug where status gems on weapons would sometimes not equip correctly
[*] The calculation of luck to adjust more correctly to the difficulty curve
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Frog-Eye" enemy would sometimes jump too high
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Frog-Eye" enemy would sometimes get stuck in the room exit doors
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes freezing the enemy would keep their movement inertia
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Low Vision" curse was not displayed correctly in battle vs "Dantilus"
[*] Fixed a bug where the weapon level would sometimes not be calculated correctly if a game was loaded into a boss room
[*] Fixed a bug where menu controls would sometimes hang when playing with the keyboard
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the "Dash" would restart incorrectly
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies would sometimes "Revive" after loading a started game
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy health was calculated incorrectly after loading a started game
[*] The algorithm for the relationship between the positive and negative values of death hexes has been modified
[*] Fixed a bug where the correct rewards would sometimes not appear after the battle with "Dantilus" after loading a started game
[*] The calculation of the damage done by the enemies based on the seed level has been modified to better adjust to the difficulty curve
[*] Fixed a bug where the double jump would not execute correctly when used in the air with a trap under the King
[*] The visual effects of the "Monks" attacks have been modified to improve their visibility
[*] Added a warning before fire traps are activated to improve their visibility
[*] The conversations with the Death have been expanded. Don't forget to chat with her!

notes.title: Summum Aeterna: Early Access Roadmap 2022
notes.content:
Summum Aeterna is a Roguelite game that combines world crawler mechanics with fast-paced combat and a unique 2D art style. Taking the role of the King of Darkness, you'll explore uncharted territories populated with treasures, traps, hordes of enemies, and powerful bosses. 

[b]Day One content[/b]

Let's take a look at what is included in the first version of the game currently available on Steam:
[list]
[*] 2 worlds featuring 2 different areas each
[*] 2 final bosses
[*] 1 special room… The Death Roulette! Featuring a mechanic that makes your run even more interesting… Would you spin it? Be careful, it could curse your game or make you unstoppable!
[*] 3 weapon types: swords, scythes, and pistols
[*] 21 unique weapons, each one with different offensive and passive attributes
[*] Introduction to the Seed Mechanic, a unique world generator system: Each seed you find generates a unique world with different enemy behaviour, rewards, special rooms, and map size depending on its genes and rareness.
[*] More than 20 unique world modifiers: The so-called “seed genes” make each seed different from the last, and so will the world generated from them!
[*] Permanent character upgrade system: No matter how many times you’re defeated, your progression in the skill tree will be saved!
[*] Permanent world upgrade system: The world improvements you unlocked will last forever, even if you are defeated a hundred times!
[*] Weapon customization options: Add new attributes and improve the combat performance of your weapons by embedding gems
[*] More than 15 epic music themes
[/list]
Everything mentioned above is already included in the current playable version of Summum Aeterna. We rely on the community feedback to improve the gaming experience. We are willing to include new features based on our player base opinions as well. Feel free to send us your suggestions and share your thoughts!


[b]Project timeline[/b]

Summum Aeterna is scheduled to be in early access for a year and a half, so the full version will be ready at some point in 2024, but there’s no specific end date. However, all main updates for the next months are already scheduled, and the content for the first half of 2023 is almost planned.


[b]Future content scope[/b]

Now that the first version is available, let’s take a look at the future content. Right now we have 4 major upgrades to cover the game progression until the end of 2022. Small patches could also be released between each main update to solve possible bugs or expand the customization possibilities. 

This is the roadmap of our first cycle in Early Access:

[*] 2 new NPCs: Rasen Lupine and the Dummy

[b]What will come after Major Upgrade 4?[/b]

[*] All the good ideas provided by the community to make Summum Aeterna even more fun!
[/list]
We will update the roadmap and the next content scope in early 2023. Thank you so much for your constant support! We rely on you to make Summum Aeterna an epic experience.
